title: LOINC terms whose COMPONENT matches ^Glucose (property regex)
exercises: regex on a concept-valued property (matches against part codes or names?)
why: Slow-ish: scans the COMPONENT prop keys; records what the regex is applied to.

expectedDifferences.reason: decision D2 (revised 2026-11-02): every regex filter matches the whole value, as the tx-ecosystem regex tests require; main's LOINC provider finds the pattern anywhere, so 'Glucose.*' on COMPONENT also matches part names that merely contain it (834 vs 823).
